data.full_text:
Fresha has earned its reputation as one of the most popular booking platforms in the beauty and wellness industry. Its combination of free core software, built-in payment processing, and marketplace visibility has attracted over 130,000 businesses worldwide. For many salons, it’s a compelling first choice.

But as your business evolves, you might discover that Fresha’s approach doesn’t align perfectly with your specific needs. Perhaps the 20% commission on new marketplace clients is eating into your growth margins. Maybe you want deeper integration with your existing WordPress website. Or you might prefer a different balance between marketplace visibility and brand control.

That’s where this guide comes in. We’ll explore dedicated alternatives that excel in specific areas, whether you’re looking to:

Integrate booking directly into your WordPress website with full control over customization and branding

Leverage AI-powered automation and specialized enterprise tools for multi-location chains

Scale your growing team with transparent, predictable pricing and no marketplace commissions

Combine salon services with fitness classes in a platform built for multi-modality wellness

Present clients with a premium, beautifully designed booking experience

Start with a genuinely free booking solution backed by an established ecosystem

Access modern features like dynamic pricing and AI marketing tools at an affordable price

Some businesses might use these tools alongside Fresha for specific capabilities, while others might replace it entirely. This isn’t about finding a “better” platform; it’s about finding the right fit for your specific situation as your business grows. Let’s dive in.

What is Fresha?

Fresha is a cloud-based booking and business management platform designed for beauty and wellness businesses, including salons, barbershops, spas, and wellness centers. The platform has grown to serve over 130,000 businesses globally, positioning itself as an all-in-one solution that combines appointment scheduling with payment processing, marketing tools, and client management.

Its key features include:

Free core booking software for solo operators: The base platform costs nothing for individual professionals, with revenue generated through payment processing fees and marketplace commissions. Team plans may require subscriptions depending on your region.

Built-in payment processing: Integrated card payments with the option to require deposits or full prepayment

Marketplace visibility: Exposure to potential new clients searching for services in your area

Client management: Customer profiles, booking history, and automated reminders

Marketing tools: Basic email and SMS campaigns, promotions, and gift cards

Team management: Staff scheduling, commission tracking, and performance insights

Source: Fresha

Fresha’s appeal lies in its accessibility: businesses can get started without upfront software costs, and the marketplace provides a built-in client acquisition channel. The platform handles the technical complexity, allowing salon owners to focus on their craft.

However, Fresha’s model includes trade-offs that become more significant depending on your priorities. The 20% commission charged on new clients acquired through the marketplace can impact margins for businesses actively seeking growth through that channel. And for salons already invested in WordPress websites or preferring self-hosted solutions, Fresha’s standalone SaaS nature represents a different approach than native integration.

That’s why we’ve focused on alternatives that take different approaches in their areas of specialty.

How We Curated Our List of Fresha Alternatives

After researching Fresha and the broader salon software market, we identified that businesses often seek alternatives when they have specific preferences around:

Full control over their booking experience and branding: The ability to customize every aspect of how clients interact with their booking system, particularly through self-hosted solutions

Zero commission fees on client acquisition: Predictable costs that don’t scale with success in attracting new clients

AI-first enterprise automation: Advanced artificial intelligence features for call handling, marketing, and analytics

Deep integration with fitness verticals: Platforms built from the ground up for wellness businesses combining multiple service modalities

Premium visual design: A booking experience that matches high-end brand positioning

A genuinely free starting point: Robust features without monthly subscription costs

Modern features like AI marketing and dynamic pricing: Next-generation tools for independent professionals

Each platform on this list takes a distinct approach in one of these specific areas. Some readers might use these tools to complement Fresha, while others might replace it entirely based on their specific requirements.

❗DISCLAIMER: We aren’t covering every salon booking platform on the market. Our focus is on highlighting alternatives that take different approaches from Fresha’s model. The goal is to help you find tools that match your particular needs.

1. Salon Booking System — Best Alternative for WordPress Users Who Want Full Control and Zero Commissions

Salon Booking System is a comprehensive appointment scheduling plugin for WordPress designed specifically for service-based businesses including hair salons, barbershops, spas, and wellness centers. Created in 2016 by Dimitri Grassi, a WordPress web designer who believed the platform could handle more ambitious projects, it has grown steadily over nearly a decade in the market. The vendor reports nearly 10,000 premium installations, while WordPress.org shows over 3,000 active installations of the free version. This longevity, with many customers staying for 5-7+ years, demonstrates the kind of trust that comes from consistent development and responsive support.

Unlike cloud-based platforms like Fresha, Salon Booking System integrates directly into your existing WordPress website, giving you complete control over the booking experience, client data, and branding. Its key features include:

Native WordPress integration: Manage everything from your WordPress dashboard with seamless shortcode embedding

Multiple service and assistant booking: Unlike many booking plugins that limit customers to selecting one service per booking, clients can book multiple services and even multiple staff members in a single session which is ideal for appointments combining haircut, color, and treatment

Advanced booking rules: Multiple availability rules, resource-based booking, and sophisticated scheduling algorithms

Annual subscription pricing: Flat yearly fees with no per-booking or per-client charges

REST API access: Full developer capabilities for custom applications and integrations

40+ official add-ons : Extend functionality with Multi-Shops, WooCommerce checkout, Service Packages, and more

Staff mobile web app: Team members can manage their schedules from any device

Google Calendar sync : Two-way synchronization keeps all schedules aligned

Custom development services: Request specific features tailored to your business needs which is accessible even for smaller salons making a few hundred reservations per month

Source: Salon Booking System

For small to medium salons (typically 1-10 employees) that have built their online presence on WordPress and want to maintain complete ownership of their booking system, client relationships, and data, Salon Booking System provides a level of control and personalized support that larger platforms approach differently.

Why Choose Salon Booking System Over Fresha

Salon Booking System takes a fundamentally different approach from Fresha’s marketplace model, which may better suit certain business needs:

WordPress Integration: Your Booking System, Your Website, Your Brand

While Fresha operates as a separate platform that either directs clients away from your website or embeds as a widget, Salon Booking System becomes part of your WordPress site. The booking form lives on your pages, styled to match your design, with no third-party branding competing for attention.

Using simple shortcodes, you can display the booking form, staff calendars, service lists, or customer account areas anywhere on your site. The [salon/] shortcode creates the main booking page, [salon_booking_calendar] displays appointments organized by assistant, and [salon_booking_my_account] gives clients a personal dashboard for managing their bookings.

Source: Salon Booking System

This native integration means your SEO efforts, blog content, and booking system work together as a unified experience. Clients stay on your website throughout most of the booking process (though payment processing may involve external gateways depending on your configuration), maintaining the brand consistency that’s essential for premium positioning.

⚡ Salon Booking System in Action: A client discovers your salon through a blog post about hair care tips on your WordPress site. Interested, they click the “Book Now” button. Instead of being redirected to a third-party platform with different branding, they see a booking form that matches your website’s design exactly. They select a haircut, add a color treatment, and include a conditioning service which is an all in one booking. They choose their preferred stylist, pick a time slot, and complete the booking. Their information stays in your WordPress database, ready for you to nurture the relationship on your terms.

Annual Subscription Pricing: Pay for the Software, Keep Your Revenue

Fresha‘s 20% commission on marketplace-acquired new clients might seem reasonable initially, but the math changes as you grow. A salon booking £5,000 worth of services from marketplace-acquired clients would pay £1,000 in commissions to Fresha.

Salon Booking System operates on straightforward annual subscription pricing:

Basic Branded: €89/year for single-site use with all PRO features

Business: €139/year for two sites with 40+ add-ons and multi-location management

Agency Pass: €299/year for up to 10 sites with white-label options

Unlimited Pass: €499/year for unlimited installations

Every booking you receive, whether from existing clients or new ones who find you through Google, your marketing efforts, or word of mouth, belongs entirely to you. The flat annual fee means your costs remain predictable regardless of how many clients you serve.

⚡ Salon Booking System in Action: You invest in local SEO and social media marketing to attract new clients. A prospect finds your salon through Google, visits your website, and books a £200 color treatment. With Fresha’s marketplace, if that client had found you through their platform, you’d pay £40 in commission. With Salon Booking System, your €89/year subscription covers unlimited bookings from unlimited clients. The more successful your marketing becomes, the better your return on investment.

Deep Customization: Rules and Logic That Match Your Business

Salon Booking System offers three booking calculation modes (Basic, Advanced, and High End) that accommodate different operational complexities. The Advanced mode handles multiple services with varying durations, while High End mode considers execution order when multiple staff members perform services in a single booking session.

Source: Salon Booking System

The resource-based booking capability is particularly valuable for spas and medspas. You can define resources like “Massage Room 1,” “Laser Equipment,” or “Pedicure Station” with specific capacities. When a client books a service linked to a resource, the system performs a three-tiered availability check: first the resource, then the service, and finally the staff member.

Source: Salon Booking System

You can create:

Multiple availability rules for complex schedules (note: overlapping rules may require careful configuration to avoid conflicts)

Holiday rules for closures and special events

Booking offsets for buffer time between appointments

Assistant-specific rules that override general availability

This level of configurability means the booking system adapts to your operations, not the other way around.

A Partnership Approach: More Than Just a Plugin Provider

One aspect that sets Salon Booking System apart from larger WordPress booking plugins is its relationship-focused approach. With a smaller, dedicated customer base rather than tens of thousands of users, the team can offer something larger competitors cannot: genuine partnership.

This manifests in several practical ways. Support is highly responsive because you’re not just another ticket in a queue. Custom development services are accessible even for smaller salons making a few hundred reservations per month. If you need a specific feature that would benefit your business, you can request it directly, and if it’s valuable to the broader customer base, it often gets integrated into the core plugin.

Many features in the current version originated as custom solutions for specific client needs before being refined and released to everyone. This customer-driven development means the platform evolves based on real salon operations, not theoretical use cases.

Developer-Friendly Architecture: Build What You Need

For businesses with unique requirements or development resources, Salon Booking System’s REST API opens possibilities that closed platforms cannot offer. The API enables:

Retrieving and inspecting booking details programmatically

Searching for availability across services and staff

Creating, updating, and canceling bookings from external applications

Building custom mobile apps with your booking system as the backend

Source: Swagger Hub

The Zapier integration extends connectivity to thousands of applications, enabling automated workflows like creating a Google Meet session for each new booking.

⚡ Salon Booking System in Action: Your salon group wants a custom-branded mobile app that connects to your booking system. Using the REST API, your developer builds an iOS and Android app that pulls real-time availability, allows clients to book appointments, and sends push notifications for reminders. With the white-label options available on Agency and Unlimited plans, your app can display your branding exclusively, depending on your implementation.

Data Ownership: Your Clients, Your Database

With Salon Booking System, core client and booking data lives in your WordPress database on your hosting server. You maintain significant control over this information, from how it’s stored to how it’s used for marketing.

The system includes data export capabilities for reservations (CSV format) and integrates with standard WordPress tools for user data management. It’s worth noting that certain features like SMS notifications, payment gateways, and integrations like Zapier may transmit some data to external services, so review your specific configuration for complete data flow understanding.

Source: Salon Booking System

This ownership extends to compliance considerations. Because you control the hosting environment, you can implement security measures and data handling practices appropriate for your jurisdiction and client base.

NOTE: We also evaluated other WordPress booking plugins including Amelia and Bookly. Comparing WordPress booking plugins is inherently complex because each platform has evolved based on its specific customer base’s needs, developing different strengths along the way. Amelia offers a clean interface with strong WooCommerce integration, while Bookly provides simplicity for basic scheduling. Salon Booking System has developed particular depth in areas that matter for salons specifically: resource-based booking for equipment-dependent services, multiple service and assistant selection in a single booking, and advanced availability rules. Perhaps equally important for smaller salons, the team’s ability to offer responsive support and accessible custom development, which larger plugins with tens of thousands of users cannot prioritize in the same way, makes it worth considering if you value a partnership approach alongside the technical features.

Salon Booking System Pricing

Salon Booking System operates on an annual subscription model with a free edition available on WordPress.org for basic needs. The license provides access to support and updates for 365 days and remains functional even after expiration (though updates and support stop).

Basic Branded Plan: €89/year

Single website installation

All PRO features including online payments, staff mobile app, and REST API

Monday to Friday email support

Business Plan: €139/year

Two website installations

Everything in Basic plus 40+ add-ons

Multi-location management capabilities

Agency Pass: €299/year

Up to 10 website installations

All add-ons included with white-label option

Non-refundable

Unlimited Pass: €499/year

Unlimited website installations

Ideal for web agencies and white-label projects

Non-refundable

A 15-day free trial is available for the Basic and Business plans to evaluate the full feature set before committing.

Who Should Use Salon Booking System?

Choose Salon Booking System if:

Your salon already has a WordPress website and you want to integrate booking directly into it rather than sending clients to a third-party platform. The native integration preserves your branding and keeps the client journey within your domain.

You’re a small to medium salon (1-10 employees) handling hundreds of reservations monthly who values personalized support and the ability to influence product development over mass-market solutions.

You prefer flat annual pricing over commission-based models. The annual subscription model means your 100th new client costs the same as your first, making your marketing investments more profitable as you grow.

You need advanced customization for complex scheduling scenarios, resource-dependent services, multi-service bookings, or unique business rules that generic booking platforms can’t accommodate.

You value a partnership approach where you can request custom features, receive responsive support, and work with a team small enough to know your business rather than treating you as one of thousands.

You prioritize data ownership and want client information stored in your own database under your control rather than in a third-party platform.

Salon Booking System may not be the right fit if you’re seeking built-in marketplace client acquisition (Fresha excels here), if you don’t have a WordPress website, or if you need enterprise-scale features for 50+ locations (consider Zenoti instead).

Ready to take control of your salon’s booking experience? Start your 15-day free trial of Salon Booking System and discover how WordPress-native booking can transform your client relationships.

2. Zenoti — Best Alternative for Enterprise Multi-Location Chains

Zenoti is a comprehensive cloud-based software platform purpose-built for beauty, wellness, and fitness industries serving over 30,000 businesses across more than 50 countries. Founded in 2010 by brothers who previously ran their own salon and spa chain and found existing software inadequate, Zenoti has achieved unicorn status with a $1.5 billion valuation. The platform provides an all-in-one solution specifically designed to handle the operational complexities that emerge when managing multiple locations.

Why Choose Zenoti Over Fresha for Multi-Location Operations

Zenoti stands out in several ways that matter significantly for businesses operating multiple locations:

True Multi-Location Architecture

Zenoti was specifically designed for chain operations. A single dashboard provides unified oversight of all locations with centralized guest profiles, cross-location booking capabilities, and consolidated reporting. Enterprise-tier features include franchise support, cross-center redemption with auto-settlement, global loyalty program management, and multi-location inventory pooling.

AI-First Platform Philosophy

Zenoti has made AI its strategic differentiator with an “AI First” approach. The Zeenie AI assistant allows natural language queries for data access. The AI Receptionist handles calls, books appointments, and manages customer inquiries. Smart Marketing uses predictive analytics to identify slow periods and automatically sends targeted promotions. Zenoti won the 2025 Industry Disruptor Award at Sibec Americas for its AI-driven innovations.

Enterprise-Grade Analytics

The platform includes 400+ pre-built reports covering financial, operational, inventory, marketing, employee, and guest data. More importantly, it provides predictive analytics including customer churn probability, appointment sales forecasts, and staff hours forecasts. Reports can be customized, saved as views, and scheduled for automatic delivery.

Source: Zenoti

🏅 NOTE: We also evaluated Mindbody and Boulevard for the enterprise segment. While Mindbody has extensive third-party integrations and Boulevard offers a polished experience favored by luxury salons, Zenoti offers a comprehensive AI-first approach combined with multi-location architecture for chains specifically needing centralized management across multiple locations.

Zenoti Pricing

Zenoti offers tiered pricing that varies by business type (Salon & Spa, Barbershop, Medspa, Fitness):

Growth Plan: Custom pricing, , includes branded online booking, automated waitlists, dynamic pricing, memberships, gift cards, Zeenie AI Copilot, 400+ reports, and 24×7 support

Hypergrowth Plan: Custom pricing, adds AI Voice Receptionist, AI Reputation Manager, integrated phone with AI insights, custom mobile app, and API access

Complete Plan: Custom enterprise pricing, adds franchise support, cross-center redemption, global loyalty management, and dedicated success team

Who Should Use Zenoti?

Choose Zenoti if:

You operate 3+ locations and need genuine centralized control with cross-location client profiles and unified reporting

You want AI automation to reduce staffing burdens through automated call handling, smart waitlists, and predictive marketing

You’re willing to invest in a premium platform with the learning curve that comprehensive enterprise features require

Get started with Zenoti today.

3. Vagaro — Best Alternative for Growing Teams Who Want Predictable Pricing

Vagaro is a comprehensive cloud-based business management platform designed for beauty, wellness, and fitness industries that provides an alternative to Fresha’s commission-based marketplace model. Founded in 2009 and valued at $1 billion following its 2021 funding round, Vagaro functions as both a SaaS business management tool and an online marketplace, offering visibility benefits without marketplace commission fees.

Why Choose Vagaro Over Fresha for Growing Teams

Vagaro stands out in several significant ways:

Transparent, Predictable Pricing

Fresha’s 20% commission on marketplace-acquired new clients can become costly as you grow. Vagaro charges a straightforward £20/month base fee for a single calendar, with £10 added for each additional team member (up to seven, after which additional calendars are free). Critically, Vagaro does not charge any commission on marketplace bookings. A 10-person salon pays approximately £90/month total regardless of how many clients come through the marketplace.

Comprehensive All-in-One Features

Vagaro includes inventory management with automated low-stock alerts, employee management with tiered commission structures, payroll processing (via add-on), email marketing with 1,000 free emails monthly, Daily Deals promotions, and the MySite website builder. This consolidates what might otherwise require four or five separate subscriptions.

Source: Vagaro

Strong Integration Ecosystem

Vagaro connects with QuickBooks, Xero, Google Calendar, Gusto for payroll, and offers API access for custom integrations. Social media integrations enable booking buttons directly on Facebook and Instagram profiles.

🏅 NOTE: We also evaluated Boulevard and Mangomint. While Boulevard excels at providing a premium experience for upscale salons and Mangomint offers a modern, developer-friendly approach, Vagaro offers strong value for teams scaling from 5-20+ staff who need extensive functionality without enterprise-level pricing.

Vagaro Pricing

Optional add-ons include Branded App (£50 one-time setup + £50/month), MySite website builder (£15/month), and automated text marketing (starting at £15/month for 250 SMS).

Who Should Use Vagaro?

Choose Vagaro if:

You’re a medium-sized salon team (5-20+ staff) seeking predictable costs without commission structures that penalize growth

You need an all-in-one platform to consolidate scheduling, inventory, email marketing, and payroll

Your business relies on existing accounting or marketing tools and needs robust third-party integrations

See how Vagaro can streamline your business.

4. Mindbody — Best Alternative for Multi-Modality Wellness Businesses

Mindbody is a comprehensive cloud-based business management platform serving over 40,000 businesses across fitness, beauty, and integrative health sectors simultaneously. The company traces its origins to 1998 (as HardBody SoftWare) and became MINDBODY in 2001. Where some platforms focus primarily on salon appointment booking, Mindbody was built to accommodate the complexities of class-based scheduling, membership management, and multi-service wellness offerings.

Why Choose Mindbody Over Fresha for Multi-Modality Wellness

Mindbody stands out for businesses operating across multiple wellness verticals:

Native Class-Based Scheduling

Mindbody natively handles group capacity management, waitlist automation with “First to Claim” SMS notifications, instructor assignment and substitution workflows, and room/resource scheduling. For businesses offering both one-on-one salon appointments and group fitness classes, this unified management provides deep capability in the fitness vertical.

ClassPass Integration

Through its 2021 acquisition of ClassPass, Mindbody provides direct access to millions of ClassPass members actively seeking wellness services. Promotional tools and dynamic pricing help fill last-minute class openings.

Video-on-Demand and Livestreaming

Mindbody supports virtual sessions and on-demand content distribution, enabling membership tiers that include digital access and livestreamed classes. For hybrid wellness businesses, this digital capability represents an additional revenue channel.

Source: Mindbody

🏅 NOTE: We also evaluated WellnessLiving and Vagaro. While WellnessLiving offers competitive class scheduling and Vagaro provides an affordable all-in-one solution, Mindbody offers comprehensive multi-modality support for businesses genuinely operating across fitness, beauty, and wellness verticals simultaneously.

Mindbody Pricing

Starter Plan: $99/month per location with core management tools and marketplace listing

Accelerate Plan: Custom pricing with advanced analytics and room management

Ultimate Plan: Custom pricing with automated marketing and lead management

Add-ons include Branded Mobile App and Messenger[ai] chatbot at additional cost. API access includes free sandbox use and the first 1,000+ calls per cycle; fees apply beyond those limits.

Who Should Use Mindbody?

Choose Mindbody if:

Your business genuinely operates across multiple wellness modalities (yoga studio with beauty services, spa with fitness classes)

Class-based revenue is central to your business model, not an occasional offering

You want marketplace discovery through Mindbody’s 2.8 million active users and ClassPass integration

Unlock your salon’s potential with Mindbody.

5. GlossGenius — Best Alternative for Independent Professionals Who Prioritize Premium Design

GlossGenius is a mobile-first business management platform purpose-built for beauty professionals who refuse to compromise on aesthetics. Founded by a former Goldman Sachs analyst who taught herself to code while working as a freelance makeup artist (the company appeared in Techstars NYC’s 2015 cohort and launched its product around 2016), the platform serves over 70,000 businesses with a $510 million valuation. Note: GlossGenius is currently US-only.

Why Choose GlossGenius Over Fresha for Premium Design

GlossGenius distinguishes itself through several philosophical differences:

Design-First Philosophy

While Fresha prioritizes marketplace functionality, GlossGenius was built with visual elegance as a core requirement. Customizable booking websites with professional themes, curated color palettes, and typography options create experiences that match brand identity. Even the card readers come in customizable patterns.

Transparent Pricing Without Marketplace Commissions

GlossGenius offers straightforward subscription pricing ($24-$148/month) and a flat 2.6% payment processing fee for standard transactions including card-present and card-on-file. Note that some payment types, such as invoices (2.9% + 30¢) and Buy Now Pay Later (6% + 30¢), carry different rates.

No Client App or Account Required

Clients can book 24/7 through a branded website without downloading an app or creating an account, removing common booking abandonment triggers.

Source:

🏅 NOTE: We also evaluated Fresha’s free plan and Goldie. While Fresha excels for those who want no upfront costs and value marketplace exposure, and Goldie targets solopreneurs with an extremely streamlined approach, GlossGenius offers a compelling combination of premium aesthetics and focused functionality for independent professionals who prioritize brand presentation.

GlossGenius Pricing

Standard Plan: $24/month (annual) or $28/month (monthly) with full booking customization and flat 2.6% processing for standard transactions

Gold Plan: $48/month (annual) with Google Booking integration, automated waitlist, and forms

Platinum Plan: $148/month (annual) with team commissions, goal setting, and advanced analytics

Who Should Use GlossGenius?

Choose GlossGenius if:

You’re an independent beauty professional who considers aesthetics non-negotiable in every client touchpoint

You want predictable costs without marketplace commissions

You need to be fully operational quickly without technical expertise (US-based businesses only)

Optimize your client experience with GlossGenius.

6. Square Appointments — Best Alternative for Solopreneurs Who Want a Free, Full-Featured System

Square Appointments is a comprehensive scheduling and POS solution from Block, Inc. that combines online booking, calendar management, payment processing, and client management in a single platform. It features a robust free tier that goes beyond basic scheduling, making it attractive for solopreneurs who want powerful tools without monthly subscription costs.

Why Choose Square Appointments Over Fresha for a Free Solution

Square Appointments stands out in several ways:

Robust Free Plan

The free tier includes unlimited appointments, a customizable booking website, automated reminders, and integrated payment processing (2.6% + 15¢). Users only pay processing fees when accepting payment. Note that some features like Google Calendar sync and cancellation/no-show fee automation may require the paid Plus tier (check current feature availability for your region).

Embedded Booking for Brand Control

Square allows businesses to embed a booking widget directly into existing websites, keeping the client journey within their branded environment. The free booking website can be customized with layout, colors, and fonts.

Native Payment Processing

Built-in payment processing supports prepayments, deposits, and cards on file. The platform supports Tap to Pay on iPhone and Android, contactless cards, Cash App Pay, and Afterpay for installments.

Source: Square

🏅 NOTE: We also evaluated Fresha’s free plan and Setmore. While Fresha excels at marketplace client acquisition and Setmore offers solid free scheduling, Square Appointments offers a strong free tier for solopreneurs who need integrated payment processing and access to a complete business ecosystem.

Square Appointments Pricing

Free Plan: $0/month with unlimited appointments, booking website, reminders, and 2.6% + 15¢ processing. Square Assistant is included on all plans.

Plus Plan: $49/month adding waitlist and lower processing at 2.5% + 15¢. Note: Square Loyalty is a separate add-on with its own fee.

Premium Plan: $149/month with resource management, 2,500 texts included, and 2.4% + 15¢ processing

Who Should Use Square Appointments?

Choose Square Appointments if:

You’re a solopreneur who needs a robust free booking system with transparent processing fees

You want to embed booking on your existing website rather than redirecting to a marketplace

You already use or plan to use Square for payments and want ecosystem integration

Simplify bookings with Square Appointments.

7. Goldie — Best Alternative for Modern, Mobile-First Solopreneurs

Goldie is a mobile-first appointment scheduling application that serves as a Fresha alternative for independent professionals who want modern booking features without marketplace competition. Originally launched as Appointfix in 2014 and rebranded in 2022, it’s trusted by over 150,000 beauty professionals worldwide.

Why Choose Goldie Over Fresha for Modern Mobile-First Booking

Goldie stands out with several innovative features:

Direct Booking Without Marketplace Competition

Goldie provides a direct online booking system where professionals maintain complete control over client relationships. Clients see only your services with no competitor listings, and no app download or account creation is required.

Innovative Revenue Features

The Dynamic Pricing feature (Pro Plus) allows automatic price adjustments based on demand. Integrated Buy Now, Pay Later through Affirm, Afterpay, Klarna, and Zip enables clients to pay in installments while professionals receive full payment upfront. Goldie reports that adopting salons have seen approximately 20% revenue increases (vendor-reported statistic).

AI-Powered Social Media Tools

The AI social media post generator (Pro Plus) creates promotional content and captions, addressing a significant pain point for solo professionals who struggle with marketing content creation.

Source: Goldie

🏅 NOTE: We also evaluated Vagaro and Square Appointments. While Vagaro excels at comprehensive features for larger teams and Square provides ecosystem integration, Goldie offers an intuitive mobile-first experience with innovative features like AI marketing tools and integrated BNPL specifically designed for solopreneurs.

Goldie Pricing

Starter (Free): 20 appointments/month, unlimited clients, manual reminders

Pro: $19.99/month with unlimited appointments, automated reminders plus 500 free SMS credits (in select countries; 200 credits in other regions), no-show protection, and BNPL

Pro Plus: $39.99/month adding dynamic pricing, AI Assistant, multiple calendars, and waitlist

Who Should Use Goldie?

Choose Goldie if:

You’re a solo professional wanting modern mobile-first booking software without the learning curve of enterprise platforms

You want innovative revenue features like dynamic pricing and BNPL to maximize earnings

You struggle with marketing and would benefit from AI-powered social media content generation

Manage your bookings efficiently with Goldie.

The Final Verdict

While Fresha excels as an accessible entry point for salons wanting free software with built-in marketplace visibility, businesses with specific requirements often benefit from more specialized tools. Based on our research, here are the best alternatives:

Salon Booking System for WordPress users who want full control, deep customization, multi-service booking capabilities, and a partnership approach with responsive support and accessible custom development

Zenoti for enterprise multi-location chains needing AI-powered automation and centralized management

Vagaro for growing teams seeking transparent, predictable pricing without marketplace commissions

Mindbody for multi-modality wellness businesses combining salon services with fitness classes

GlossGenius for independent professionals who prioritize premium design and brand presentation (US only)

Square Appointments for solopreneurs wanting a genuinely free system with integrated payments

Goldie for mobile-first solopreneurs who want modern features like dynamic pricing and AI marketing tools

Remember, you don’t have to choose between Fresha and these alternatives exclusively. Many businesses successfully use different tools for different purposes as their needs evolve. Consider your specific requirements, technical environment (particularly if you have a WordPress site), and growth trajectory when deciding which solution fits best.

Record-breaking openings, key partnerships, and recognition on top franchise industry award cement Sola Salons as the industry leader in independent beauty entrepreneurship DENVER, Dec. 4, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- Sola Salons, the world's largest studio suite concept and home to more than 21,000 independent beauty and wellness professionals, is experiencing a powerful surge in Q4 growth fueled by major openings, strategic innovation and national recognition. This quarter, the company advanced its market position with the launch of a powerful new partnership with Vagaro - delivering industry-leading booking, payment, and client-management tools directly to Sola's network of independent professionals - alongside the rollout of its new benefits program in partnership with Ep6ix, offering access to comprehensive health and insurance options for Sola Pros. The brand also reached landmark real-estate milestones, including the opening of its 750th location in Greenville, South Carolina, and the debut of its largest studio ever, a 101-suite, 29,903-square-foot flagship in Northeast Minneapolis designed to showcase the future of independent beauty entrepreneurship at scale. Demonstrating the strength and stability of its model, Sola secured a top-tier ranking of #184 on the 2025 Franchise Times Top 400, underscoring the brand's category dominance and sustained nationwide growth. Combined with continued expansion into new markets, accelerated multi-unit development, and the rollout of several new technology platforms and operational enhancements to support franchisees, Sola Salons will enter 2026 with unmatched momentum and a clear leadership position in the booming salon suite industry. "This quarter marks an extraordinary chapter in Sola Salons' growth story," said Daryl Hurst, President & COO of Sola Salons. "Our partnership with Vagaro empowers our beauty professionals with the best tools to manage and grow their businesses, while milestones like our 750th location and our largest studio ever highlight the power of our franchise model and the trust franchisees place in our brand. We are proud to lead the salon suite industry, and we go into 2026 with extraordinary innovation, and a commitment to helping independent professionals across the U.S. and Canada thrive." With 750 locations across the U.S. and Canada supporting more than 21,000 independent beauty and wellness professionals, Sola Salons has established itself as a premier destination for independent beauty professionals seeking to operate their own businesses in a high-quality, community-driven environment. Each new Sola Salons location features a collection of fully equipped private salon suites designed to accommodate hair stylists, estheticians, nail technicians, massage therapists, and other beauty professionals. The Sola Salons model offers beauty and wellness professionals the opportunity to join a vibrant community with access to exclusive education, marketing support, and industry-leading resources, and - newly launched this year - a comprehensive Sola Pro benefits program. Looking ahead, Sola Salons is poised to continue its growth trajectory with several openings slated over the next few months in key markets including in Wilmington, NC in early December; and Cleveland, OH; Altamonte, FL; Boca Raton, FL; Frisco, TX; Durham, NC; and Charlotte, NC in 2026. This continued expansion reinforces Sola's position as a category leader, extending its reach to new communities and creating more opportunities for beauty professionals to take control of their careers. By scaling its proven model, Sola is not only meeting growing demand but also deepening its impact by empowering thousands of independent professionals to thrive on their own terms within a supportive, elevated environment. Sola Salons continues to expand into new markets, accelerate multi-unit franchise development, and provide enhanced technology and operational support to franchisees - including the rollout of several new technology platforms and the introduction of a benefits program - solidifying its leadership position in the booming salon suite sector. data.full_text:
Flexible funding delivers 26% average revenue growth while helping prevent over 400 business closures LONDON, December 04, 2025--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Liberis, a leading global embedded finance provider, today released its latest Impact Report, which reveals that embedded finance drives measurable revenue growth for more than three-quarters of SMBs, with 90% reporting positive operational impact. The comprehensive survey of over 1,700 small business customers across the US and UK demonstrates how accessible, flexible funding is transforming small business resilience in an era of economic uncertainty. The research shows that businesses receiving Liberis funding through partner platforms saw an average revenue increase of 26% in the following 12 months, with the majority (53%) achieving growth between 10-25%. Critically, over 400 businesses indicated that Liberis funding may have prevented their closure, with 71% of struggling businesses reporting they were facing shutdown within the year before accessing capital. "Small businesses are navigating a perfect storm of inflation, rising costs, and fragmented access to finance. Our research proves that embedded finance isn't just convenient, it's transformative," said Rob Fairfield, CEO of Liberis. "When you deliver the right funding at the right time, through platforms businesses already trust, you unlock genuine growth. These aren't just numbers; they're thousands of stories of survival, expansion, and ambition realised." Barriers and rejections The research exposes deep fractures in traditional small business lending. Seventy-two per cent of respondents had never accessed funding before Liberis, with many locked out entirely by conventional lenders. Among those who struggled to secure traditional finance: 48% cited outright application rejection as the primary barrier

42% said lenders "didn't understand their business type"

39% found funding too expensive with inflexible terms

Some businesses applied four or more times and were rejected repeatedly The research underscores a fundamental mismatch: traditional lenders fail to understand modern business models, particularly the 69% of US respondents operating e-commerce businesses and the 34% of UK hospitality and food service operators. Embedded finance – a solution that delivers Liberis' embedded approach - delivering funding through trusted partner platforms like eBay, Worldpay, and Vagaro - eliminates these barriers. For 72% of respondents, Liberis represented their first-ever funding, accessed seamlessly through platforms they already use daily.

Story Continues

Speed emerged as the critical differentiator. The Liberis Capital Platform can deliver funding in just 4 hours from application to disbursement, compared to weeks or months with traditional lenders. This velocity matters: 58% of businesses require extra capital during seasonal peaks like Christmas, when timing is everything. The funding is being deployed strategically: 68% invested in new stock and inventory

21% purchased new equipment and machinery

18% invested in marketing and customer acquisition

Many used funds to manage unexpected costs and supplier price increases Partnership value - loyalty through expanded offerings The research reveals a powerful opportunity for platform partners embedding Liberis finance. Sixty-eight per cent of respondents said they would likely stay with their current platform if more financial products were offered, with US businesses showing particularly strong commitment at 74% compared to the UK's 46%. Additional findings demonstrate demand for personalised, lifecycle-based finance: 82% agree their financial needs evolve over time

57% want personalized funding recommendations

78% expect to seek additional funding to address future challenges

76% favour Flexible Cash Advance products that adjust to sales performance "For our partners, embedded finance is more than a product feature, it's a retention and growth engine," added Fairfield. "Businesses that feel financially supported become stickier customers. When platforms expand their financial offerings, they're not just helping their customers grow; they're future-proofing their own business model." Economic resilience in uncertain times The report documents how Liberis funding serves as both a growth accelerator and a stabilisation tool during economic turbulence. With 67% of respondents citing inflation and cost-of-living pressures as their top challenge, flexible capital has proven essential: 55% agreed Liberis helped them withstand external economic factors

47% would have missed critical growth opportunities without funding

27% would have survived but struggled significantly

21% would have dipped into personal savings Beyond survival, the funding creates tangible community impact. Most businesses reported creating or saving at least one job, with 29% preserving or adding two to five roles. UK respondents particularly emphasised local community contributions, from supporting local suppliers to charitable involvement. About the Survey The Liberis Impact Report draws on responses from 1,737 of Liberis’ small business customers: 411 in the UK and 1,326 in the US, across 42 questions covering funding experiences, business challenges, revenue impact, and future needs. Respondents represent diverse industries including e-commerce (50% overall), retail (16%), hospitality and food services (7%), and personal services (6%). The majority (91%) employ 0-5 people, and 57% describe themselves as in growth or scaling phases. About Liberis Liberis is on a mission to unleash the power of small businesses all over the world - delivering the financial products they need to grow through a network of global partners. At its core, Liberis is a technology-driven company, bridging the gap between finance and small businesses. They use data and insights to help partners understand their customers' real time needs and tech to offer tailor-made financial products. Empowering small businesses to grow and keep their independent spirit alive is central to their vision. Since 2007, Liberis has funded over 70,000 small businesses with over $3bn - but they believe there is much more to be done. data.title: 10 Best HIPAA Compliant Medical Spa Software in 2025
data.ai_summary: The article presents a comparative review of ten software platforms designed for medical spas, emphasizing their compliance with HIPAA regulations and specific aesthetic practice management features. The list includes vendors such as Consentz, AestheticPro, Meevo, Nextech, Symplast, PatientNow, SimplePractice, DrChrono, Vagaro, and Pabau. It highlights that selecting appropriate software is critical for protecting patient data and avoiding significant financial penalties associated with regulatory violations.
data.full_text: ​One data breach. That’s all it takes to destroy your medical spa’s reputation and drain your bank account with HIPAA fines reaching up to $1.5 million per violation. Yet, 88% of medical spas still rely on generic booking software that leaves patient data vulnerable to cyberattacks and regulatory violations. In 2025, choosing HIPAA compliant medical spa software isn’t just about convenience—it’s about protecting your patients, safeguarding your business, and ensuring you can sleep at night without worrying about compliance nightmares. The right software encrypts sensitive health information, automates consent documentation, and provides audit trails that keep federal regulators satisfied. This comprehensive guide examines the 10 best HIPAA compliant medical spa software platforms that combine bulletproof security with powerful practice management features. From patient intake to billing, from consent forms to electronic medical records, we’ll help you find the perfect solution for your aesthetic practice. Best HIPAA Compliant Medical Spa Software Solutions for 2025 Selecting the right medical spa software requires balancing robust security features with operational efficiency. Each platform below has been evaluated based on HIPAA compliance certifications, data encryption standards, user experience, integration capabilities, and overall value for aesthetic practices. 1. Consentz – Best Overall HIPAA Compliant Medical Spa Software Consentz stands as the gold standard for HIPAA compliant medical spa software in 2025, specifically engineered for aesthetic clinics, medspas, and dermatology practices. Unlike generic healthcare platforms, Consentz was built from the ground up to address the unique compliance challenges of cosmetic medicine while delivering an exceptional patient experience. Key Features: • End-to-End Encryption & HIPAA Compliance: Bank-level 256-bit encryption protects all patient data in transit and at rest. Automatic HIPAA compliance monitoring with built-in Business Associate Agreements (BAAs) and comprehensive audit logs that track every access point to protected health information (PHI). • Digital Consent Management: Revolutionary consent workflow that captures legally binding e-signatures on HIPAA-compliant forms, treatment consents, before-and-after photo authorizations, and financial agreements. Automated consent reminders reduce liability while improving patient compliance. • Integrated EMR/EHR System: Purpose-built electronic medical records designed specifically for aesthetic treatments including Botox, dermal fillers, laser procedures, and body contouring. Customizable treatment templates, automated SOAP notes, and photo documentation with facial mapping tools. • Smart Appointment Scheduling: AI-powered booking system that reduces no-shows by 67% through automated SMS and email reminders. Online scheduling portal integrates seamlessly with your website while maintaining HIPAA compliance for patient communications. • Advanced Patient Portal: Secure patient portal allows clients to complete intake forms, upload insurance information, review treatment plans, and access their medical records 24/7—all within a HIPAA-compliant environment. • Comprehensive Billing & Revenue Cycle Management: Integrated payment processing with PCI-DSS compliance, automated insurance claims submission, treatment package management, and detailed financial reporting that identifies revenue opportunities. • Clinical Photography & Documentation: Secure photo storage with automatic facial recognition tagging, side-by-side comparison tools, and progress tracking that creates compelling before-and-after galleries while maintaining HIPAA compliance. • Marketing Automation Tools: Built-in CRM with patient segmentation, automated email campaigns, review request workflows, and loyalty program management—all designed to grow your medspa while respecting patient privacy. • Multi-Location Support: Centralized dashboard for multi-location practices with location-specific reporting, provider scheduling, and inventory management across all your medspa locations. • Mobile-First Design: Native iOS and Android apps allow providers and staff to access patient records, update treatment notes, and manage schedules from anywhere while maintaining enterprise-grade security. Why Consentz Leads: Consentz eliminates the complexity of managing multiple software systems. Instead of juggling separate platforms for scheduling, EMR, consent forms, and billing, you get a unified clinic operations ecosystem that ensures HIPAA compliance across every patient touchpoint. The platform’s aesthetic-specific features mean you’re not paying for irrelevant medical modules designed for primary care or hospitals. Best For: Medical spas, aesthetic clinics, dermatology practices, plastic surgery centers, and cosmetic medicine practices of all sizes seeking comprehensive HIPAA compliance with aesthetic-specific functionality. 2. AestheticPro – Comprehensive Practice Management AestheticPro delivers a robust practice management solution tailored for medical spas and aesthetic practices. The platform combines HIPAA-compliant EMR functionality with inventory management and marketing tools designed specifically for cosmetic treatments. Key Features: • HIPAA-Compliant Cloud Infrastructure: Secure cloud-based system with encrypted data storage and automatic backups. Includes signed BAAs and regular security audits to maintain compliance standards. • Aesthetic-Focused EMR: Customizable charting templates for Botox, fillers, lasers, and body contouring procedures. Integrated photo documentation with treatment timeline visualization. • Inventory & Product Management: Real-time tracking of cosmetic products, automatic reorder alerts, and lot number documentation for FDA compliance. Integrates with major aesthetic product distributors. • Online Booking & Scheduling: Patient-facing booking portal with real-time availability, automated confirmations, and waitlist management. Calendar syncs across providers and treatment rooms. • Point-of-Sale System: Integrated POS for retail sales, treatment packages, and membership programs. Accepts all major payment methods with secure, encrypted processing. • Marketing Suite: Email campaign builder, loyalty rewards program, referral tracking, and automated birthday/anniversary promotions to boost patient retention. Best For: Established medical spas with significant product retail operations and multiple treatment providers needing comprehensive inventory control. 3. Meevo – Enterprise-Grade Spa Management Meevo (formerly Millennium) provides enterprise-level spa and salon management software with HIPAA compliance features added for medical spa operations. The platform excels in multi-location management and staff scheduling complexity. Key Features: • HIPAA Compliance Module: Optional HIPAA compliance add-on with encrypted storage, access controls, and audit logging. Requires separate BAA signing and additional monthly fees. • Advanced Staff Management: Sophisticated scheduling engine with commission tracking, performance analytics, and automated payroll integration. Handles complex rotation schedules and provider preferences. • Multi-Location Dashboard: Centralized management console for franchise and multi-location operations with location-specific reporting, cross-location booking, and centralized inventory. • Client Relationship Management: Comprehensive CRM with client history, preference tracking, automated marketing campaigns, and detailed analytics on client lifetime value. • Retail & Inventory System: Advanced inventory management with automatic reordering, supplier management, and retail POS integration. • Mobile App Access: iOS and Android apps for staff scheduling, client communication, and point-of-sale transactions on the go. Best For: Large medical spa chains and franchise operations requiring sophisticated multi-location management and complex staff scheduling. 4. Nextech – Medical-Grade EHR Platform Nextech specializes in healthcare technology for specialty practices, including plastic surgery and medical aesthetics. The platform offers medical-grade EHR functionality with built-in HIPAA compliance and practice management tools. Key Features: • Certified EHR System: ONC-certified electronic health records with full HIPAA compliance, meaningful use reporting, and interoperability with other healthcare systems. • Advanced Clinical Documentation: Comprehensive charting with voice-to-text dictation, customizable templates for aesthetic procedures, and integrated e-prescribing capabilities. • Medical Photography Suite: Professional-grade photo management with HIPAA-compliant storage, before-and-after galleries, morphing tools, and secure patient sharing. • Revenue Cycle Management: Integrated billing with insurance verification, claims scrubbing, denial management, and automated patient payment collections. • Patient Engagement Portal: Secure portal for appointment scheduling, form completion, treatment plan review, and encrypted messaging with providers. • Practice Analytics: Detailed reporting on clinical outcomes, financial performance, patient demographics, and provider productivity metrics. Best For: Plastic surgery practices and medical spas requiring certified EHR functionality with extensive insurance billing capabilities. 5. Symplast – All-in-One Aesthetic Platform Symplast combines practice management, EMR, and patient engagement tools specifically designed for plastic surgery and medical aesthetics. The cloud-based platform emphasizes HIPAA security while delivering modern patient communication features. Key Features: • HIPAA-Secure Communication: Encrypted messaging between staff and patients, secure photo sharing for consultations, and compliant video conferencing for virtual visits. • Aesthetic EMR: Procedure-specific charting for injectables, lasers, skin treatments, and surgical procedures with customizable templates and automated documentation. • Digital Forms & Consent: Paperless intake process with electronic consent forms, medical history questionnaires, and photo release authorizations with e-signature capture. • Before-and-After Gallery: HIPAA-compliant photo management with automatic categorization, comparison tools, and secure patient access for treatment tracking. • Telehealth Integration: Built-in telemedicine platform for virtual consultations, follow-up appointments, and remote patient monitoring with full HIPAA compliance. • Marketing Automation: CRM with automated patient journeys, review management, social media integration, and referral tracking to grow your practice. Best For: Tech-savvy practices prioritizing patient communication and engagement alongside HIPAA compliance and clinical documentation. 6. PatientNow – Aesthetic Practice Growth Platform PatientNow focuses on helping aesthetic practices grow revenue while maintaining HIPAA compliance. The platform combines practice management with advanced marketing and sales tools designed for cosmetic medicine. Key Features: • HIPAA-Compliant Infrastructure: Encrypted cloud storage with regular security audits, signed BAAs, and comprehensive access controls for all user roles. • Sales Pipeline Management: CRM designed for aesthetic consultations with lead tracking, conversion analytics, and automated follow-up workflows to maximize bookings. • Customizable Charting: Flexible EMR with procedure-specific templates, photo documentation, treatment planning tools, and integrated prescription management. • Online Booking & Scheduling: Patient-facing scheduler with real-time availability, automated reminders, and waitlist management to reduce no-shows. • Membership Programs: Built-in recurring revenue management for Botox clubs, maintenance programs, and VIP memberships with automated billing. • Business Intelligence: Advanced reporting on key performance indicators, treatment profitability, provider productivity, and patient lifetime value. Best For: Growth-focused medical spas emphasizing sales processes, consultation conversion, and membership-based revenue models. 7. SimplePractice – User-Friendly Medical Practice Software SimplePractice offers straightforward practice management with strong HIPAA compliance features. While not specifically designed for medical spas, it provides essential functionality for smaller aesthetic practices and solo practitioners. Key Features: • Built-In HIPAA Compliance: Automatic HIPAA compliance included in all plans with encrypted storage, secure messaging, and signed BAA at no additional cost. • Simple Client Portal: Easy-to-use patient portal for appointment booking, intake form completion, and secure document sharing. • Telehealth Capabilities: Integrated video conferencing for virtual consultations with unlimited sessions and automatic session notes. • Basic Charting & Notes: Clinical documentation with customizable templates, progress notes, and treatment plan tracking. • Insurance & Billing: Integrated payment processing with insurance claims submission, automated patient invoicing, and payment plan management. • Calendar Management: Simple scheduling with appointment reminders, color-coded calendars, and recurring appointment support. Best For: Solo practitioners and small aesthetic practices seeking affordable, easy-to-use software with essential HIPAA compliance features. 8. DrChrono – Mobile-First EHR Solution DrChrono delivers a mobile-optimized EHR platform with comprehensive HIPAA compliance. The iPad-native design appeals to tech-forward practices, though it lacks some aesthetic-specific features found in specialized platforms. Key Features: • ONC-Certified EHR: Fully certified electronic health records with HIPAA compliance, interoperability standards, and meaningful use attestation support. • iPad-Optimized Interface: Native iPad application for bedside charting, patient check-in, and real-time documentation during procedures. • Practice Management Suite: Integrated scheduling, billing, patient communications, and revenue cycle management in a unified platform. • Patient Check-In Kiosk: Tablet-based check-in system for waiting room use with insurance card scanning, digital signature capture, and co-pay collection. • API & Integrations: Extensive API for custom integrations with third-party applications, labs, pharmacies, and medical imaging systems. • Medical Billing Services: Optional full-service billing department to handle claims submission, denial management, and revenue optimization. Best For: Medical spas wanting certified EHR functionality with strong mobile capabilities and extensive integration options. 9. Vagaro – Budget-Friendly Spa Software Vagaro provides affordable salon and spa management software with HIPAA compliance features suitable for medical spas on a tight budget. The platform prioritizes ease of use and online booking functionality. Key Features: • HIPAA Compliance Package: Optional HIPAA compliance add-on with encrypted storage, access controls, and signed BAA for medical spa operations. • Online Booking Widget: Embeddable booking widget for your website and social media with real-time availability and automated confirmations. • Mobile App: Free mobile app for both business and customers with appointment management, client communication, and payment processing. • Marketing Tools: Email and SMS marketing campaigns, automated review requests, daily deal promotions, and gift certificate sales. • Point of Sale: Integrated POS system for service payments, retail sales, and tip processing with all major payment methods accepted. • Client Management: Basic CRM with appointment history, notes, preferences, and automated birthday reminders. Best For: Budget-conscious medical spas and day spas offering limited medical services requiring basic HIPAA compliance. 10. Pabau – International Medical Aesthetics Platform Pabau serves the global medical aesthetics market with HIPAA compliance for US-based practices alongside GDPR compliance for international operations. The platform offers comprehensive practice management with strong inventory and product tracking. Key Features: • Multi-Regional Compliance: HIPAA compliance for US practices with additional GDPR, UK Data Protection Act, and Australian Privacy Act compliance built-in. • Advanced EMR: Comprehensive medical records with procedure-specific templates, photo documentation, prescribing capabilities, and lab integration. • Stock Management: Detailed inventory tracking with batch numbers, expiry date monitoring, supplier management, and automated stock alerts. • Patient Journey Automation: Automated workflows for appointment confirmations, pre-treatment instructions, post-treatment care, and review requests. • Multi-Currency Support: International pricing and payment processing with currency conversion for practices serving global clientele. • Reporting & Analytics: Comprehensive business intelligence with custom report builder, KPI dashboards, and treatment outcome tracking. Best For: International aesthetic practices and US medical spas with international clientele requiring multi-regional compliance. Conclusion Selecting the right HIPAA compliant medical spa software isn’t just about checking boxes on a compliance checklist—it’s about finding a partner that understands the unique demands of aesthetic medicine. The platforms reviewed above represent the cream of the crop for 2025, each offering robust data protection, secure patient communications, and the documentation tools necessary to satisfy federal regulations. For most medical spas and aesthetic clinics, Consentz emerges as the clear winner thanks to its purpose-built design for cosmetic medicine, comprehensive feature set, and transparent pricing. The platform eliminates the need for multiple software subscriptions while delivering enterprise-grade HIPAA compliance that scales from solo practitioners to multi-location operations. However, your ideal choice depends on your specific needs. Larger practices with complex insurance billing may prefer Nextech’s certified EHR capabilities, while budget-conscious startups might find Vagaro or SimplePractice more appropriate for their current scale. International practices should seriously consider Pabau’s multi-regional compliance features, and tech-forward providers may appreciate DrChrono’s mobile-first approach. When evaluating options, prioritize these critical factors: 1. Verified HIPAA Compliance: Ensure the platform provides signed Business Associate Agreements, maintains SOC 2 certifications, and conducts regular third-party security audits. 2. Aesthetic-Specific Features: Look for pre-built templates for cosmetic procedures, integrated photo management, and consent forms tailored to aesthetic treatments. 3. Integration Capabilities: Verify compatibility with your existing tools, payment processors, and any specialized equipment like imaging systems. 4. Total Cost of Ownership: Calculate not just monthly fees but also setup costs, training expenses, transaction fees, and potential upgrade costs. 5. Customer Support: Confirm availability of 24/7 technical support, especially during your peak business hours. Remember, the cost of HIPAA non-compliance far exceeds any software investment. A single data breach can result in fines ranging from $100 to $50,000 per violation, with maximum annual penalties reaching $1.5 million. Beyond financial penalties, the reputational damage from inadequate record-keeping can permanently destroy patient trust and tank your practice’s growth. Take advantage of free trials and demos before committing. Most platforms offer 14-30 day trial periods—use this time to test workflows with your actual staff, import sample patient data, and verify that critical features work as advertised. Pay special attention to how the software handles consent management and electronic medical records, as these are the areas most scrutinized during HIPAA audits. The investment in proper HIPAA compliant medical spa software pays dividends through reduced administrative burden, improved patient satisfaction, streamlined operations, and most importantly—peace of mind knowing your practice is protected against compliance violations and data breaches. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) What makes software HIPAA compliant for medical spas? HIPAA compliant software must encrypt all protected health information (PHI) both in transit and at rest using industry-standard 256-bit encryption. The vendor must sign a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) accepting liability for data breaches. The platform needs comprehensive access controls, automatic session timeouts, detailed audit logs tracking all PHI access, secure backup systems, and regular security audits by third-party assessors. For medical spas specifically, the software should handle digital consent forms, treatment documentation, before-and-after photos, and patient communications—all within the HIPAA-secure environment. Do I need HIPAA compliant software even if I only offer cosmetic treatments? Absolutely. Any medical spa or aesthetic clinic that stores patient health information electronically must comply with HIPAA regulations, regardless of whether treatments are considered medical or cosmetic. This includes basic information like medical history forms, allergy documentation, prescription records (even for topical treatments), treatment notes, and before-and-after photographs. The misconception that “cosmetic-only” practices are exempt from HIPAA has led to costly violations. If you’re collecting any health-related information from patients and storing it electronically, HIPAA compliance is mandatory. Learn more about starting a compliant medical spa from the ground up. What are the penalties for HIPAA violations in medical spas? HIPAA violations carry severe financial penalties ranging from $100 to $50,000 per violation, depending on the level of negligence. Annual maximum penalties can reach $1.5 million per violation category. For example, if a data breach exposes 500 patient records due to inadequate security measures, penalties could exceed $25 million. Beyond federal fines, many states impose additional penalties. Violation of state privacy laws can add hundreds of thousands in fines. More damaging than financial penalties is the reputational harm—patients lose trust immediately when their private medical information is compromised, often resulting in practice closure. Can I use regular appointment scheduling software for my medical spa? Using non-HIPAA compliant scheduling software is extremely risky for medical spas. Popular consumer-grade booking platforms like Calendly, Acuity, or Square Appointments do not provide Business Associate Agreements and lack the encryption standards required for protected health information. If your scheduling system collects or displays any patient medical information—treatment history, medical conditions, medications, or even appointment reasons that reveal medical details—you need HIPAA compliant software. Many practices have faced violations because their “innocent” booking system inadvertently exposed patient treatment information through confirmation emails or calendar integrations. How much does HIPAA compliant medical spa software typically cost? Pricing varies significantly based on features and practice size. Budget options like Vagaro and SimplePractice start around $25-99/month for basic HIPAA compliance and essential practice management. Mid-tier platforms like Consentz, Symplast, and PatientNow range from $199-399/month with comprehensive features specifically designed for medical aesthetics. Enterprise solutions like Nextech and Meevo can exceed $599/month per provider, justified by certified EHR functionality and advanced capabilities. Implementation fees typically range from free (for simpler platforms) to $15,000+ for enterprise systems. Calculate total cost of ownership including monthly fees, setup costs, training, transaction fees, and any per-provider charges. What’s the difference between EMR and EHR in medical spa software? Electronic Medical Records (EMR) are digital versions of paper charts containing patient treatment history within a single practice. Electronic Health Records (EHR) go further by sharing patient information across multiple healthcare providers and facilities. For most medical spas, EMR functionality suffices—you need to document treatments, track patient progress, and maintain HIPAA-compliant records within your practice. EHR becomes important if you regularly exchange patient information with referring physicians, coordinate care with other specialists, or operate in a healthcare system requiring interoperability. Many platforms marketed as “EHR” for aesthetics are actually EMR systems with limited external sharing capabilities. Understanding comprehensive patient management systems helps clarify these distinctions. Should I choose cloud-based or on-premise HIPAA software? Cloud-based HIPAA compliant software is overwhelmingly the better choice for medical spas in 2025. Modern cloud platforms provide enterprise-grade security that would cost hundreds of thousands to replicate on-premise—including redundant data centers, 24/7 monitoring, automatic security updates, and disaster recovery. Cloud solutions eliminate the need for expensive IT staff, server maintenance, and hardware upgrades. You can access patient records from any device with proper authentication, enabling providers to work remotely or across multiple locations. On-premise systems made sense when internet connectivity was unreliable, but today’s encrypted cloud platforms actually provide superior security compared to typical in-office servers. How do I transition from paper records to HIPAA compliant software? Transitioning from paper records requires careful planning but delivers immediate benefits. Start by selecting software that offers data migration assistance—many vendors provide complimentary or low-cost migration services. The typical process involves: (1) Scanning existing paper charts and consent forms, (2) Uploading documents to the new HIPAA-compliant system with proper patient matching, (3) Training staff on digital workflows before going live, (4) Running parallel systems for 2-4 weeks to catch any issues, and (5) Securely destroying or archiving paper records according to state retention laws. Most practices complete migration in 4-8 weeks. The key is starting with active patients first rather than attempting to digitize decades of inactive records immediately. What should I look for in a Business Associate Agreement (BAA)? A comprehensive Business Associate Agreement must clearly define how the software vendor will protect your patient data and what happens during a breach. Key elements include: explicit acknowledgment that they’re handling protected health information, commitment to implement appropriate safeguards, agreement to report any security incidents within specific timeframes (ideally 24-48 hours), prohibition on using or disclosing PHI except as permitted, requirements for secure data destruction when terminating service, and acceptance of liability for breaches caused by their negligence. Red flags include vendors who refuse to sign BAAs, agreements with vague language about data security, or contracts that attempt to disclaim liability for data breaches. Never use software for patient data without a signed BAA. Can I integrate HIPAA compliant software with my existing tools? Integration capabilities vary significantly across HIPAA compliant platforms. Leading solutions like Consentz, Nextech, and Symplast offer robust integration ecosystems connecting with payment processors (Stripe, Square), accounting software (QuickBooks, Xero), marketing platforms (Mailchimp, Constant Contact), and review management tools (Birdeye, Podium). However, each integration must maintain HIPAA compliance—you cannot simply connect any third-party tool that handles patient information. Always verify that integration partners also sign BAAs and maintain proper security standards. Some platforms provide open APIs allowing custom integrations, while others offer pre-built connectors for popular services. Evaluate integration needs during software selection to avoid discovering critical incompatibilities after implementation.

data.ai_summary: Google has announced a major expansion of AI Mode in Search, introducing travel-planning and booking capabilities including Canvas (a planning workspace), AI-powered flight deals across 200+ countries, and integrations with restaurant, event, and accommodation booking partners. The feature positions Google as an end-to-end travel assistant that manages discovery, comparison, and booking within a single AI-driven flow, raising competition concerns about the company acting as a de facto gatekeeper that shapes visibility and market access for travel providers. The development has drawn scrutiny from regulators and competition experts who warn that AI-led intermediation could disadvantage smaller hotels, OTAs, and independent providers while entrenching Google's ecosystem advantages.
